title: Automatic Shiny App Conversion
text: parse_shiny_app() reads app’s R source extracts structured intermediate representation (IR): parser handles app.R (single-file) ui.R/server.R (split-file) apps. walks AST find every *Input() call (id, type, label, arguments), every *Output() call (id type), body server function, reactive() expression inputs depends , observe() observeEvent() call, every input$name input[["name"]] reference. parser classifies apps complexity:
code: ir <- parse_shiny_app("path/to/my-shiny-app") ir ── Shiny App IR ─────────────────────────────────────── Path: path/to/my-shiny-app Inputs: 4 Outputs: 2 Reactives: 1 Observers: 0 Complexity: medium Input refs: species, x_var, y_var, trend

title: Automatic Shiny App Conversion
text: analyze_reactive_graph() takes IR builds dependency graph: analyzer builds dependency graph whose nodes inputs, reactives, outputs, edges data flow: input$x used reactive(...) used renderPlot(...). runs union-find find connected components, grouping nodes transitively connected. connected component becomes one tool, component’s inputs arguments outputs return values. text: Maintainer: James Wade github@jameshwade.com

title: shinymcp (development version)
text: shinymcp now targets stable MCP Apps specification (2026-01-26, https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps): server now checks client’s capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"] extension capability initialize. Clients don’t advertise MCP Apps support receive tools without _meta.ui annotations, degrade gracefully text-operation. Core protocol version negotiation now follows MCP spec: server echoes supported requested version (2024-11-05 2025-11-25) otherwise responds latest, instead taking string minimum. JS bridge handshake (ui/initialize) uses apps protocol version 2026-01-26 declares availableDisplayModes. ui/update-model-context now sent request semantics per spec (previously notification). server bridge answer ping.

title: shinymcp (development version)
text: mcp_app() gains resources: declare extra resources (static strings lazily-evaluated functions) served alongside app readable UI via new window.shinymcp.readResource(uri) — spec’s view-side resources/read. enables lazy-loading large datasets instead inlining app HTML. Supported real chat hosts, bundled Shiny host, preview_app(). mcp_app() gains tool_outputs: declare output ids tool returns shinymcp generates spec-compliant outputSchema per tool, property descriptions derived matching UI output types. convert_app() scaffolds emit suggested mapping (commented placeholder tool bodies completed). HTTP transport now implements basic streamable-HTTP session management: Mcp-Session-Id assigned initialize, per-client session state (protocol version, UI capability) keyed header, DELETE terminates session. Previously concurrent HTTP clients shared one session clobber ’s capability negotiation. mcp_app() gains csp, permissions, prefers_border arguments. publish _meta.ui metadata (CSP domain declarations, iframe permissions, border hint) app’s ui:// resource resources/list resources/read, hosts can allow declared external domains. Apps fully inlined assets (default) need none . mcp_app() gains tool_visibility scope tools _meta.ui.visibility: "app"-tools hidden model, "model"-tools hidden rendered UI. Plain-list tools can also carry visibility outputSchema fields directly. mcp_app() gains trigger debounce_ms standalone apps (just Shiny-hosted ones) can control input changes call tools. bridge now applies host context: host’s theme maps data-bs-theme (bslib UIs built-component CSS follow chat client’s light/dark mode automatically), locale sets document language, styles.variables become CSS custom properties. Context updates via ui/notifications/host-context-changed merged re-applied; shinymcp’s Shiny host propagates page theme live. New window.shinymcp JS API inside apps: callTool(), updateModelContext(), openLink(), sendMessage(), requestDisplayMode(), log(), getHostContext(). bundled Shiny host implements ui/open-link maps ui/request-display-mode fullscreen toggle, notifying apps display-mode changes.

title: shinymcp (development version)
text: bridge now handles JSON-RPC error responses: failed tools/call requests reject Promise (log console) instead leaving UI silently stuck. (Previously error responses dropped pending requests never settled.) Clients don’t advertise MCP Apps extension still receive deprecated flat _meta["ui/resourceUri"] key, draft-era hosts keep rendering UI nested _meta.ui block remains gated negotiated capability. HTTP transport hardening: unknown Mcp-Session-Id values get 404 instead minting sessions, header-less clients keep negotiated capabilities via "__default__" alias, session store capped oldest-first eviction. ui/update-model-context debounced (one request per quiet period instead one per keystroke), bridge settles pending requests teardown. window.shinymcp API always returns Promise; without host (teardown) calls reject instead returning null. bundled Shiny host answers unimplemented request methods JSON-RPC -32601 error instead fake {} success, window.shinymcp.sendMessage() friends reject honestly unsupported. mcp_tools() (shinychat/mcptools path) now honors tool_visibility: app-tools excluded model registration, plain-list tools carry _meta.ui tools/list. mcp_app(trigger = , debounce_ms = ) now takes effect embedded hosts: mcp_host_server()/mcp_embed() default app’s declaration instead silently overriding , serve()/ preview_app() warn app declares host-"submit"/"manual" modes. Resource content coerced plain string, content = function() jsonlite::toJSON(...) works documented (json class previously leaked wire format broke JSON.parse app). tool_visibility/tool_outputs entries naming nonexistent tool now warn instead silently ignored.
